notes.subject: themselves
notes.rationale: Hebrew leaves the object of “they humbled” unexpressed; the reflexive pronoun is supplied

notes.subject: and you say, 'Arrogance'
notes.rationale: גֵוָה is either the object of השפילו (“they humbled the arrogant one”) or a quoted word you pronounce (“you say, ‘Arrogance’”); many render “then you shall say, ‘There is lifting up’”

notes.subject: ושח
notes.rationale: שַׁח construct occurs only here; its picture of sunken lowliness is kept

notes.subject: the downcast of eyes
notes.rationale: could also be read as a vocative or attributive phrase, “he who has sunken eyes”

translation: For they humbled ⟨themselves⟩ and you say, “Arrogance,” and he saves the downcast of eyes.
